findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/unlock-layer3-real-execution-udm-baseline.md:197 declares productionSafetyClaim=LOCKED and globalCapabilityClaim=LOCKED as Phase 1 success criteria, and lines 680-705 make higher-layer locks part of DONE. But the required final report schema and PASS rejection contract at lines 523-645 only carry claimBoundary prose plus Authority booleans; they do not require structured productionSafetyClaim=LOCKED/globalCapabilityClaim=LOCKED fields or matching rejection predicates. A report could therefore satisfy the documented realExecutionUdm=PASS contract while omitting machine-checkable proof that Production Safety and the global Capability Claim remained locked. This weakens the claim boundary and conflicts with the process rule that gate-consumed facts must be structured rather than inferred from prose. Add explicit higher-layer lock fields/summary and require them in the PASS rejection predicates.
